ravi: Heads-up: new inbound from a DoD supplier. Requirements summary: 7-year immutable audit retention, BYOK with cross-account discovery, signed exports, and a legal-hold API. They also want proof-of-storage (periodic attestations). Ticket: https://jira.redwood.ai/browse/DOD-1024.

zoe: Thanks. A couple clarifying Qs: 1) BYOK — do they expect us to import keys into our KMS or perform a remote-wrapping handshake where they keep keys? 2) Proof-of-storage: are they asking for Merkle-root style attestation or signed monthly snapshots?

mike: Security: preferred pattern is remote-wrapping handshake (we never hold plaintext). If they insist on import/escrow we need HSM escrow + legal. For proof-of-storage we can support signed monthly manifests containing root hashes of the archived blobs; manifest sigs tied to tenant KMS key.

carmen: Product/Legal: export formatting must include chain-of-custody metadata: event_id, tenant_id, actor_id, timestamp, originating-region, event-hash, previous-hash. Also need a retention-hold endpoint for subpoenas. We should standardize a manifest schema v1.0 and add a compatibility note for downstream SIEMs.

ravi: SE ask: sketch an API surface we can show them ASAP. Minimal endpoints: POST /v1/retention (create/update bucket), POST /v1/retention/{id}/hold, POST /v1/retention/{id}/release, POST /v1/kms/handshake, POST /v1/export/jobs. Export payload should be NDJSON lines with base64 payload and event-hash. Example export entry: ```json
{"event_id":"evt-0001","tenant":"acme-supplier","ts":"2024-11-15T12:34:56Z","payload_b64":"SGVsbG8=","event_hash":"3f786850e387550fdab836ed7e6dc881de23001b"}
```

zoe: For BYOK handshake we should document supported providers (aws-gov-kms, azure-dod-kv) and include key attestation step: return kms_key_arn, key_fingerprint, attestation_cert.

mike: Risk list: 1) cross-account access management complexity, 2) long-tail storage costs + egress for exports, 3) legal constraints on cross-border replication. Add requirement for HSM attestation artifacts in SOC2 docs.

ops-bot: Created ticket INF-1507 and linked to epic ENTERPRISE-RETENTION. Canary plan set: 2 gov tenants + 1 non-gov for validation.

ravi: Proposed MVP scope (P0 items): - per-tenant retention policy (90d | 1yr | 7yr archival) - BYOK handshake (remote-wrapping) w/ aws-gov and azure-dod - export job API w/ signed manifest (sha256 + sig by tenant key) - retention-hold/unhold APIs - periodic storage attestation reports (monthly). Exclude for MVP: HSM escrow import, live querying of archived data, automated cross-region replication.

carmen: Acceptance criteria (for SEs & Sales to sign): 1) BYOK handshake flow documented and exercised in staging for both providers, 2) Export job returns NDJSON + manifest.sig; manifest contains root_hash, signer, timestamp, and signed by tenant key, 3) Retention policy can be set per-tenant via API and surfaces in Console, 4) Retention-hold toggles immediately prevent deletion and appear in audit logs, 5) Monthly storage attestations produced and available via /v1/attestations endpoint.

zoe: Engineering estimate: core work areas = KMS handshake layer (1.5 sprint), retention lifecycle + archival lifecycle (1 sprint), export job pipeline + manifest signing (1 sprint), UI + Console hooks (0.5 sprint), infra provisioning & cost model (0.5 sprint). Total ~4.5 sprints across teams including QA. Needs security review before canary.

mike: I'll own the security checklist: key attestation, threat model for export workers, RBAC rules for cross-account, and requirement for HSM certificates from vendors.

ravi: Next steps: 1) schedule joint triage with Security & Infra (30m) this week, 2) draft manifest schema and example NDJSON bundle (zoe), 3) SEs to prep a customer-facing spec (carmen), 4) infra to run a storage-cost sensitivity analysis (ops). @zoe @mike @carmen please ack.

zoe: ack. Will drop manifest sketch to INF-1507 today. :white_check_mark:

mike: ack. Starting checklist now. :lock:

carmen: ack. I'll prepare legal hold API language for sales and include retention export terms.

ops-bot: INF-1507 updated with attachments: manifest-draft-v0.1, attestation-proposal.pdf.
